title: HTTP2: Modified to use common streaming reassembly helper function in epan/reassemble.c
description:
Since the reassemble_streaming_data_and_call_subdissector() of 'epan/reassemble.c' is originated from the mechanism of HTTP/2 streaming reassembly and have some enhancements. It is easy to modify HTTP/2 back to use this common helper function (and other related functions). It is also beneficial for resolving common streaming reassembly issues found in the future.

Add '-2' in test/suite_dissection.py because some reassembly issues may happen in the second pass.

A helper function additional_bytes_expected_to_complete_reassembly() is added for checking if the current streaming reassembly is complete (especially at the end of a capture file).

To run GRPC over HTTP/2 streaming reassembly related test cases in build directory:

```powershell
pytest --program-path .\run\RelWithDebInfo\ -k "grpc or http2"
```

+/**
+ * How many additional bytes are still expected to complete this reassembly?
+ *
+ * @return How many additional bytes are expected to complete this reassembly.
+ *         It may also be DESEGMENT_ONE_MORE_SEGMENT.
+ *         0 means this reassembly is completed.
+ */

+additional_bytes_expected_to_complete_reassembly(streaming_reassembly_info_t* reassembly_info);
